reference_interpretation: Absolute inherited active-end deficit remains, but actual replacement is an exact subset of original copper and introduces no copper or new missing-reference region. No arbitrary endpoint mask/exemption used.
split_area_note: Native gain-inside/outside clipping areas are separately reported and do not perfectly sum because additional Boolean clipping introduces submicron-area slivers. Arithmetic remainder and explicit residual are provided; neither normalized nor used to waive strict global plane loss.
